memos.risk:
Risk officer read: this is a borderline case, and I'd lean toward refusing.

The curve data is alarming. Bundle share and top-3 share both read 1.0 and "buyers" is 1.0, which points to coordinated early buying, and the completer share of 2.87 is anomalous. The "ORGANIC" label conflicts with that. A launch bot was present, and 117 buyers in the first two minutes is thin relative to the 165 SOL of early buying.

Liquidity is about 144 SOL, so a $20 ticket would be roughly 0.1 SOL, but the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost is material against a 20-50% stop.

If the desk insists on buying anyway: $5 ticket, 25% stop, 30-minute hold maximum, exit early if sell-to-buy ratio stays above 0.7 or depth drops below 100 SOL.

I would refuse any size if bundling is confirmed, if the 30-minute high drawdown exceeds 15% before entry, or if the desk can't verify the operator concentration. Skipping costs nothing.
memos.scout:
The strongest honest case is the post-graduation flow. In the first two minutes, 117 buyers outside the agent put in 165.6 SOL, and the top-5 buyers hold only 23.5% of that volume. Sells were 0.69x buys, so early holders weren't rushing out. Over the last 15 minutes, 245 buyers committed 45.8 SOL against 31.2 SOL of sells, a net inflow of 14.6 SOL, and the price is up 22% on $9.4k volume. Drawdown from the 30-minute high is zero, and the coin is alive at 30 minutes, which clears the window where most coins die.

The case is weakened by the curve data: bundle share and top-3 share both read 1.0, and the completer share is 2.87. That pattern suggests coordinated early buying that may not reflect broad demand, and a launch bot was present. The 30-minute return of 179% also means a lot of the move is already priced in, and a 1.4-5.1% round trip plus a 30-second execution lag eats into any short-term edge. Without evidence that the buying is independent of the bundle, this is a fair but unproven case, and the base rates favor skipping.
memos.skeptic:
Most likely loss path: insider distribution after a bundled launch. The curve data shows bundle_share 1.0 and top3_share 1.0, meaning the early supply was taken by bundled wallets rather than organic buyers, and completer_share of 2.87 suggests a few wallets carried the graduation. Launch bot present, with sell_to_buy at 0.69 in the first two minutes after graduation, shows insiders already taking profit. The last 15 minutes still show net inflow of 14.56 SOL, but sellers (74) and sell_sol (31.22) are substantial, and the 30-minute return of +179% sets up a large bag for bundled holders to unload into any dip.

With a 143.98 SOL pool, a $20 ticket is small enough to be absorbed, but a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost plus a sudden 20-30% pullback would leave us underwater. Pass.
